I need a quote for 50 proposals a week. @@@@@@I am seeking an experienced and talented proposal writer to help me win new clients and secure projects in financial analysis and Excel-related niches!I have been fairly successful in securing projects on Upwork, but I am now looking for a professional and creative proposal writer to join me and provide me with a helping hand.Job Responsibilities:• I do not want template-based proposals, you should be able to draft customized and keyword-rich proposals.• Create professional and creative proposals for our financial analysis, financial valuation, corporate valuation, financial modeling, data visualization, and advanced Excel-related projects including VBA.• Write engaging cover letters that capture the attention of potential clients and convince them of our expertise.• Collaborate with me regularly to understand project requirements and develop customized solutions that meet client needs.• Search for suitable jobs on Upwork and other platforms send me the link to the job link with the proposal, or I can make you the manager of my agency.• Provide feedback and suggestions to improve our proposal writing process and increase our chances of winning projects.Qualifications:• At least 3 years of experience writing winning proposals in the financial analysis and Excel-related domains, we need proof of your success.• Strong writing skills with the ability to create professional, persuasive, and engaging proposals.• Understanding of financial analysis, financial valuation, corporate valuation, financial modeling, data visualization, and advanced Excel-related projects including VBA.• Excellent communication skills and attention to detail.• Familiarity with Upwork and other platforms for freelancers is preferred.Compensation: We are open to discussing different compensation models, and we would be happy to hear your suggestions on how you would like to work with us. I do not want hourly proposals, I need a quote for 50 proposals a week.Based on your profile and success rate, I can offer a fixed pay, fixed + variable performance (% of my earnings through you) or a complete variable performance pay (higher % of my earnings through you) I am really open to this.We are looking for a long-term commitment, and we are willing to invest in your skills and expertise.If you are an experienced proposal writer who is passionate about financial analysis and excel-related projects and familiar with platforms such as Upwork, I would love to hear from you.You must have proven track records of similar jobs. Additionally, please let us know how you would like to structure your compensation. We look forward to hearing from you.
